moves.name: Essence
moves.body: Write five essence words and the dominant data shape before opening the codex.

moves.name: Fit test
moves.body: Shortlist themes whose essence words match two or more U1 words and whose data shapes include the U1 shape.

moves.name: Triptych
moves.body: Three concepts. At most one is theme-led, so the comparison stays honest. A theme-led concept still needs its own subject-specific S1.

moves.name: Ledger
moves.body: No theme repeats in consecutive builds, or twice in one register within three builds. Check the card's collision note.

moves.name: Dial
moves.body: Set intensity from the register: Full, Tempered or Boardroom.

moves.name: Slots
moves.body: Fill S1 to S5 from the card's web slot map. Every effect still resolves through your effect library.

moves.name: Swap test
moves.body: Run the Homage Rule swap test and the safety table. Log homage-check PASS or FAIL.

moves.name: Manifest
moves.body: Record the theme line in the build manifest.

stages.D, I: Phase 1: decide format and modules. A theme never picks the format.
stages.U1: Essence extraction: five words and the dominant data shape.
stages.U2: Concept triptych: three directions, at most one theme-led.
stages.R: Register and look: intensity, palette, type.
stages.C: Code: tokens, fonts and the build.
stages.T: Tests: homage swap test, safety and accessibility.
stages.M: Manifest: the record that ships with the build.

precedence: Budgets, reduced motion, accessibility, honesty, licensing.
Client tokens replace ground, ink and type; the theme lends motion.
Evoke the genre, never the property.
The last word, never the first.
intake: The agent may propose at most one theme inside the triptych.
Forces a theme. The fit test still runs, and a failed fit is flagged, not silently obeyed.
manifest_format: theme: TX-## CODENAME · intensity · fit score · homage-check PASS/FAIL
manifest_example: theme: TX-03 GLASS HUD · boardroom · fit 4/5 · homage-check PASS
ledger_rule: A theme never repeats in consecutive builds, and never appears twice in the same register within three builds. Rows from before the codex get none in the Theme column.
